summary: Equitable Holdings filed an 8-K updating the status of a merger-of-equals with Corebridge Financial. Under the terms announced March 26, 2026, Equitable and Corebridge will merge via two subsidiary mergers, with a newly formed holding company (New Equitable) surviving and renamed Equitable Holdings. Shareholders will receive New Equitable common stock; no per-share price, premium, or break fee is disclosed. Both boards recommend the deal. The definitive joint proxy/prospectus, declared effective June 23, 2026, has been mailed; shareholder votes are pending. Watch for shareholder approval and regulatory clearance timelines.
